51296-the-sense-of-wonder.title: The Sense Of Wonder
51296-the-sense-of-wonder.creator: Unknown
51296-the-sense-of-wonder.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Chuls' reminder fostered uneasiness. Often Rikud had dreamed of the time he would be thirty and a father. Whom would the Calculator select as his mate? The first time this idea had occurred to him, Rikud ignored it. But it came again, and each time it left him with a feeling he could not explain. Why should he think thoughts that no other man had?

arxiv-2012-11216.title: Nonlinear Tikhonov regularization in Hilbert scales with oversmoothing penalty: inspecting balancing principles
arxiv-2012-11216.creator: B. Hofmann, C. Hofmann, P. Mathé, R. Plato
arxiv-2012-11216.description: Abstract . The analysis of Tikhonov regularization for nonlinear ill-posed equations with smoothness promoting penalties is an important topic in inverse problem theory. With focus on Hilbert scale models, the case of oversmoothing penalties, i.e., when the penalty takes an infinite value at the true solution gained increasing interest. The considered nonlinearity structure is as in the study B.

arxiv-2104-07134.title: Application of a new transient-noise analysis tool for an unmodeled gravitational-wave search pipeline
arxiv-2104-07134.creator: Kentaro Mogushi
arxiv-2104-07134.description: Abstract Excess transient noise events, or “glitches”, impact the data quality of ground-based GW ( GW ) detectors and impair the detection of signals produced by astrophysical sources. Identification of the causes of these glitches is a crucial starting point for the improvement of GW signal detectability.

arxiv-2203-15775.title: Random quasi-phase-matching for pulse characterization from the near to the long wavelength infrared
arxiv-2203-15775.creator: Brandin Davis, Tobias Saule, Carlos A. Trallero-Herrero
arxiv-2203-15775.description: Abstract Experiments requiring ultrafast laser pulses require a full characterization of the electric field to glean meaning from the experimental data. Such characterization typically requires a separate parametric optical process. As the central wavelength range of new sources continues to increase so too does the need for nonlinear crystals suited for characterizing these wavelengths.

arxiv-2306-15498.title: Using Large Language Models to Provide Explanatory Feedback to Human Tutors
arxiv-2306-15498.creator: Jionghao Lin, Danielle R. Thomas, Feifei Han, Shivang Gupta, Wei Tan, Ngoc Dang Nguyen, Kenneth R. Koedinger
arxiv-2306-15498.description: Abstract Research demonstrates learners engaging in the process of producing explanations to support their reasoning, can have a positive impact on learning. However, providing learners real-time explanatory feedback often presents challenges related to classification accuracy, particularly in domain-specific environments, containing situationally complex and nuanced responses.

arxiv-2312-07432.title: Flexible hierarchical risk modeling for large insurance data via NumPyro
arxiv-2312-07432.creator: Christopher Krapu, Mark Borsuk
arxiv-2312-07432.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by Christopher Krapu, Mark Borsuk. Abstract

Data analysis and individual policy-level modeling for insurance involves handling large data sets with strong spatiotemporal correlations, non-Gaussian distributions, and complex hierarchical structures. In this research, we demonstrate that by utilizing gradient-based Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) techniques accelerated by graphics processing units, the trade-off between complex model structures and scalability for inference is overcome at the million-record size.

arxiv-2401-00089.title: Conditions for eigenvalue configurations of two real symmetric matrices: a symmetric function approach
arxiv-2401-00089.creator: Hoon Hong, Daniel Profili, J. Rafael Sendra
arxiv-2401-00089.description: Abstract For two real symmetric matrices, their eigenvalue configuration is the arrangement of their eigenvalues on the real line. We study the problem of determining a quantifier-free necessary and sufficient condition for two real symmetric matrices to realize a given eigenvalue configuration as a generalization of Descartes’ rule of signs.

arxiv-2410-07613.title: Explainability of Deep Neural Networks for Brain Tumor Detection
arxiv-2410-07613.creator: Sunyoung Park, Jihye Kim
arxiv-2410-07613.description: Abstract Medical image classification is crucial for supporting healthcare professionals in decision-making and training. While Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have traditionally dominated this field, Transformer-based models are gaining attention. In this study, we apply explainable AI (XAI) techniques to assess the performance of various models on real-world medical data and identify areas for improvement.

arxiv-2410-11777.title: Measure estimation on a manifold explored by a diffusion process
arxiv-2410-11777.creator: Vincent Divol, Hélène Guérin, Dinh-Toan Nguyen, Viet Chi Tran
arxiv-2410-11777.description: Abstract From the observation of a diffusion path ( X t ) t ∈ [ 0 , T ] (X_{t})_{t\in[0,T]} on a compact connected d d -dimensional manifold ℳ \mathcal{M} without boundary, we consider the problem of estimating the stationary measure μ \mu of the process.

arxiv-2504-12499.title: An Absorption Correction for Reliable Pair-Distribution Functions from Low Energy X-ray Sources
arxiv-2504-12499.creator: Yucong Chen, Till Schertenleib, Andrew Yang, Pascal Schouwink, Wendy L. Queen, Simon J. L. Billinge
arxiv-2504-12499.description: Abstract This paper explores the development and testing of a simple absorption correction model for processing x-ray powder diffraction data from Debye-Scherrer geometry laboratory x-ray experiments. This may be used as a pre-processing step before using PDFgetX3 to obtain reliable pair distribution functions (PDFs).

pmc-11713479.title: The association between the age and the rate of tau accumulation and spreading in different sexes
pmc-11713479.creator: Zeyu Zhu, Amir Dehsarvi, Sebastian Niclas Roemer, Anna Steward, Anna Dewenter, Mattes Gross, Fabian Wagner, Michael Ewers, Matthias Brendel, Nicolai Franzmeier
pmc-11713479.description: BackgroundNeuroimaging studies have revealed age and sex‐specific differences in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) trajectories. pmc-12516095.title: A Rare Congenital Triad in an Adult With Coronary Artery Disease: A Case Report From Georgia
pmc-12516095.creator: Zviad Bakhutashvili, Lia Janelidze, Nino Lortqipanidze, Konstantine Bliadze, Natia Tamazashvili
pmc-12516095.description: A 47-year-old man with a history of New York Heart Association (NYHA) class III heart failure and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation presented with recurrent chest pain, exertional dyspnea, and exercise intolerance. He was diagnosed with an acute myocardial infarction and underwent stenting of the left anterior descending artery.

pmc-12590145.title: Major genes and phenotyping of indigenous chickens of the western highlands of Cameroon
pmc-12590145.creator: Blaise Arnaud Hako Touko, Janvier Dorian Pouani, Gwladys Laure Medontem, Vanessa Audrey Tagny Nebo, Shey Dogmis Yoniwo, Nadine Jeutsop Voutsa, Diana Muluh, Ngintendem Tangomo Armel, Yacouba Manjeli
pmc-12590145.description: The Western highlands of Cameroon (WHC) are known for their diverse indigenous chicken phenotypes (ICW), making it difficult to report their performance and adaptability attributes accurately. A study was conducted on 828 adult ICWs sampled from the Noun and Menoua administrative divisions, representing 61% of the surface area of the WHC.

pmc-12598246.title: LSM4 as a potential prognostic indicator and therapeutic target in triple-negative breast cancer progression
pmc-12598246.creator: Zhen Ren, Yifan Li, Xiaobing Yang, Nannan Zhang, Feiran Wang, Zhixian He
pmc-12598246.description: BackgroundLSM4 belongs to the LSM (Like-Sm) gene family; however, its role in triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) progression remains mostly unclear. Consequently, this study aimed to explore the mechanistic importance of LSM4 as a regulatory element in the progression of TNBC.MethodsThe expression of LSM4 was found to be evaluated through various bioinformatics approaches.

pmc-12652199.title: Genetic Diversity and Population Structure of Farmed Longfin Batfish (Platax teira) in the South China Sea
pmc-12652199.creator: Yayang Gao, Baosuo Liu, Huayang Guo, Kecheng Zhu, Lin Xian, Nan Zhang, Tengfei Zhu, Dianchang Zhang
pmc-12652199.description: Background: Longfin batfish (Platax teira) is an important economic species in southern China. In recent years, its wild population has significantly declined due to overfishing. Around 2015, breakthroughs in the artificial large-scale seedling technology for P. teira have promoted the growth of its aquaculture scale in regions such as Hainan and Guangdong.

pmc-12821836.title: Reinterpretation of the clinical and biological behaviors of papillary thyroid carcinoma subtypes within the 2022 WHO classification: a cross-sectional study of 768 cases
pmc-12821836.creator: Ying-Jie Xu, Chen Qian, Wei-Qi Kong, Dong-Lai Fan, Wei-Wei Liu, Yue-Mei Hu, Cheng-Guang Yang
pmc-12821836.description: BackgroundLimited comprehensive evaluations have been conducted to date regarding the clinical behavior of papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) subtypes based on the 2022 World Health Organization (WHO) classification of thyroid neoplasms.MethodsA total of 768 patients who underwent surgical treatment for PTC were retrospectively categorized into 12 subtypes according to the 2022 WHO classification system.

pmc-13272057.title: A case report and literature review of proton pump inhibitors inducing insulin autoimmune syndrome
pmc-13272057.creator: Wenrui Zhang, Jiayan Wen, Siming Qi, Guohui Zhang, Xubin Yang, Longyi Zeng, Wen Xu, Hongrong Deng
pmc-13272057.description: BackgroundInsulin autoimmune syndrome (IAS) is an autoimmune endocrine disorder characterized by hyperinsulinemia, positive insulin autoantibodies (IAA), and hypoglycemia. IAS was previously thought to be induced by drugs containing thiol groups.ObjectiveWe describe a case highlighting that IAS may be temporally associated with a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) exposure.

pmc-13478123.title: Acute effects of sports with different metabolic loads on serum irisin, BDNF, and NRF2 levels and cognitive performance in sedentary young adults: a comparative analysis of basketball and tennis protocols
pmc-13478123.creator: Cemre Can Akkaya, Canan Ceylan
pmc-13478123.description: Background and objectivePhysical exercise triggers coordinated neurobiological responses. This study compared the acute effects of high-intensity intermittent (basketball) versus moderate-intensity continuous (tennis) exercise on serum irisin, BDNF, and NRF2 levels, and on working memory and inhibitory control in sedentary young adults (18–25 years).MethodsSixty sedentary male participants (n = 20 per group) completed basketball, tennis, or passive control protocols.

uslaw-usc-t2-s610.title: 2 U.S.C. § 610 — Repayment of student loan on behalf of employee
uslaw-usc-t2-s610.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t2-s610.description: United States Code, Title 2 (The Congress); Chapter 17 (Congressional Budget Office). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authorization The Director of the Congressional Budget Office may, in order to recruit or retain qualified personnel, establish and maintain on and after November 12, 2001, a program under which the Office may agree to repay (by direct payments on behalf of the employee).
